So the park, for lack of a better name, we call it Martague Park, and the community park component is this area here, which would comprise parking and multipurpose field, multipurpose sport pad, pathways, a play structure, playing fields, a community garden, an outdoor education area, and a dog park, and a trail that connects, runs through the wooded area, and also a path connecting all the components, and the school is over here, so there would be a link to the school on this side. Other fees are incidental, and these would be the two primary reasons you would provide a facility of this nature. The balance would come from largely people in Smith Falls because those are the groups that largely responded to the survey, and they seem to be the most likely to use a facility in Montague. And staff we spoke to at the other facilities were very clear on the need to proactively promote facility, the facility to optimize rentals, and to work with the community to build programming activities that can occur in off-peaks time. So it's not a case of build it and they will come. It really is deliberate work to optimize the use and revenue generation of the facility. Within each, things could be done as smaller projects over time.
